# PerfAtlas — Full Directory Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Complete catalog of all 150 Apache JMeter plugins, 4 curated stacks, interactive tools, and 36 tutorials on https://plugins.jmeter.ai. Generated: 2026-11-26.

## Quick Install Reference

Install any plugin via JMeter Plugins Manager CLI:
```bash
PluginsManagerCMD.sh install <plugin-id>
```

## Curated Collections

### CI/CD Stack (https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ci-cd-stack/)
Everything you need to run JMeter in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI — validate the test plan before the run, auto-stop the test when KPI thresholds breach, and emit a clean results report your pipeline already understands.
Auto-populated stack.

### Observability Stack (https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/observability-stack/)
Push JMeter test results in real time to external monitoring backends so you can watch SLAs, latency, and throughput in the same dashboards your ops team already uses — no post-run data import required.
Auto-populated stack.

### Load Shaping Stack (https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/load-shaping-stack/)
Move beyond simple thread-count ramps. Control exact requests-per-second schedules, use concurrency-based thread groups that scale to demand, and back it all with an auto-stop listener so your tests never run away.
Auto-populated stack.

### AI-Ready Starter (https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ai-ready-starter/)
A curated selection of plugins that are AI-Ready — meaning they have been tested and validated for use with AI-assisted tooling and workflows. This collection is auto-populated from the AI-Ready registry and updates automatically as new plugins earn the badge.
Auto-populated stack.

### Command-Line Graph Plotting Tool (`jpgc-cmd`)
- URL: https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jpgc-cmd/ | Markdown: https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jpgc-cmd.md
- Vendor: JMeter-Plugins.org | Downloads: 5,806 | Weekly: +496
- JMeter Compatibility: 2.13+
- Install: `PluginsManagerCMD.sh install jpgc-cmd`
- Summary: There is small command-line utility for generating graphs out of JTL files. It behave just like right-click context menu on all graphs. The tool can generate PNG, CSV or both. Note you can use GraphsGeneratorListener if you want to bulk generate graphs after a test or for existing results.

### WebSocket Samplers by Peter Doornbosch (`websocket-samplers`)

- JMeter Compatibility: 3.1+
- Install: `PluginsManagerCMD.sh install websocket-samplers`
- Summary: Provides 6 samplers for load testing WebSocket applications. Use the WebSocket request-response sampler for testing a basic request-response flow (the most common case), or combine the other samplers to support a more sophisticated WebSocket test scenario.

- URL: https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/interval-controller/ | Markdown: https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/interval-controller.md
- Vendor: Georgii Kaliaev | Downloads: 13 | Weekly: +11
- Repo Health: 75/100 (Active)
- Install: `PluginsManagerCMD.sh install interval-controller`
- Summary: Logic Controller that executes nested elements at most once per configured interval per JMeter thread, only when the thread encounters the controller. Supports optional retry-on-failure, jitter, dynamic interval expressions, and token refresh helpers. SKIP does not sleep or block sibling samplers. Not a Timer and not a background scheduler.
